chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq uses this hadith to articulate the doctrine of *al-Husna* (the Good), asserting that Allah’s perception and decree are inherently pure, free from any defect or evil. This reflects the Shia theological emphasis on divine justice (*Adl*) and benevolence, distinguishing God’s essence from the contingent evils found in creation. It serves as a foundational proof for the idea that all divine acts, whether perceived as good or bad by humans, originate from a source of ultimate goodness.
